_comment: Where the price services the app asks for token prices live: the base url of each one's api, with its version where the url carries one, and no trailing slash. Every request to a service is built on its baseUrl, so a service that moves its api is changed here and nowhere else. Which of a chain's tokens a service can price is a separate matter, set per chain in chains.json → priceServices. Read by src/price-service-urls.js, which stops startup when a value is not an https url, naming it.
